name: hergy-webvendor
comment: The three packages the WebUI is built on, pinned to exact versions (no ^ or ~): preact, htm, @preact/signals. build-site.js builds internal/web/static's scripts from internal/web/src through these (go run ./tools/check webbuild -write), and internal/web/tsconfig.json maps the packages' names to this node_modules so bun and tsc find them. Preact 11 is beta, so the 10 line is the one pinned here.
